models.doc: ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── CLIENT — company master, flat (no parent/child). Addresses in ClientLocation. ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── One row per organisation, whatever we sell it (CSR, B2B, …). What differs by line of business hangs off the client in its own table (ClientFinancial = CSR figures, ClientCorporateFinancial = company figures), never as a copy.
